ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 12.5
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 6

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

5. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

7. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

8. Solve for x: x + 9 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 9
   D. 7

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 40 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 31
   C. 49
   D. 41

10. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 22
   C. 28
   D. 33

12. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 25

13. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

14. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 25

15. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

16. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

17. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 36
   C. 30
   D. 18

19. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

20. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

21. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

22. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.7
   D. 23.6

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

24. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
